The '''Underground Sea''' was a large body of water that lay beneath the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. It was located near to the [[Magraddor mountain range]] and a number of tunnels built by the [[Stereb]] led into it.
